response.query: For quasi-experiments, which tests (parallel-trends, placebo windows, event-study) and robustness checks (E-values, bounding, falsification) will we predefine and how will we choose between DiD and synthetic controls?
response.answer: For quasi-experiments, we will predefine parallel-trends, placebo windows, and event-study tests. We will choose between DiD and synthetic controls based on data availability and comparability. E-values, bounding, and falsification robustness checks will also be used.
